text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During training time, Special Week
approached me with a serious expression.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... Trainer...
This is... really hard to say, but...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I've put on some weight recently...
It's quite embarrassing...
choice_data_list: Then shall we do some extra training...!
Then let's do some extra training...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best to trim down my weight!
I look forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After running for a while,
Special Week successfully managed to lose weight.
